newsitem.title: FRANCE: French rap singers jailed for anti-police lyrics.
newsitem.headline: French rap singers jailed for anti-police lyrics.

text.p: Two singers for a French rap band have been given three-month jail terms and banned from performing for six months for using song lyrics attacking the police, justice officials said on Friday.

Bruno Lopez, also known as Kool Shen, and Didier Morville, called Joey Star, of the rap group NTM were sentenced by a criminal court in Toulon on Thursday after being convicted of attacking public authorities via their songs.
NTM stands for "Nique Ta Mere" (Fuck Your Mother).
Lopez, who is 30, and Morville, 29, will appeal the sentences, their lawyers said.
The predominantly North African band has won celebrity, and notoriety, with such song lyrics as "Kill the cops" and "Let's go to the presidential palace and kill all the old people".
One of their songs, "Fuck the police," describes police as "an organised gang, hierarchical, protected by the highest authorities".
The far-right National Front party has launched a campaign to prevent the group from performing at concerts and festivals receiving public funding.

Last June, after National Front leaders complained, prefect Jean-Charles Marchiani of the Var department in southeastern France pressured a festival near Toulon to cancel an NTM concert by threatening to withdraw subsidies.

His action was criticised as censorship by politicians on both the Right and the Left. Socialist ex-culture minister Jack Lang accused Marchiani, a member of the ruling Gaullist party, of "playing by the rules of the National Front".
The front, led by the fiery Jean-Marie Le Pen, embraces traditional family values and vehemently opposes immigration.
